name: RecordSet
summary: An in-memory representation of tabular data, as rows and columns rather than as objects.

roles.name: RecordSet
roles.summary: Tabular data carried as tabular data. It earns its place where the code, the tools and the platform all already speak rows and columns — a report, a grid, an import — and it is the wrong shape the moment behaviour needs to attach to a row rather than to the set.
